name: Cygnus Finance Global USD
oneLiner: cgUSD is Cygnus Finance's rebasing USD stablecoin on Base, backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries and stablecoins, with daily rebases reflecting NAV.
collateral: Off-chain U.S. Treasury exposure and on-chain stablecoins, with actual holdings and weights undisclosed in the reviewed issuer pages; supply rebases on New York banking days to portfolio NAV including interest. Native Base minting deposits USDC.
pegMechanism: Daily rebase on New York banking days aligns supply with portfolio NAV; USDC redemption uses Cygnus's Request + Claim withdrawal flow, normally taking 5-7 days. The withdrawal FAQ quotes a 35-basis-point fee and warns that Treasury price fluctuations can reduce the claimable amount.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Cygnus describes cgUSD as collateralized by short-term U.S. Treasuries, with total supply synchronized to portfolio net asset value on New York banking days and a 1:1 USDC redemption path. This is a Treasury-backed, NAV-rebasing stablecoin rather than a borrower-CDP or fiat cash-only issuance design.
